Highlights of IIM Nagpur 2024

The Indian Institute of Management Nagpur (IIMN) is one of the top-class business schools in India situated in Nagpur, Maharashtra. It started its journey in 2015 under the guidance of IIM Ahmedabad. On July 23, 2015, IIM Nagpur welcomed its inaugural class for Post Graduate Programme (PGP). 

IIM Nagpur was the first one among the six new-generation management schools established in 2015. In November 2021, the institution relocated to its new campus at MIHAN in Nagpur, Maharashtra. The site has an area of 132 acres.

As a premier institute of higher learning for the next generation, IIM Nagpur is committed to producing innovative thinkers and doers who are highly demanded by the finest companies of India as well as abroad. The objective is to reach internationally recognised benchmarks while creatively responding to the demands of modern India.

The Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business (AACSB) has accepted IIM Nagpur as a member that shares its goal of developing future business leaders. Thus, IIM Nagpur hopes to strengthen its ties with the international community and have a positive impact on business education all around the world.

Academic endeavours at IIM Nagpur India serve major stakeholders including industry, society, students, and faculty. The purpose of the institution rests on three pillars: excellent teaching and learning, cutting-edge research, and extensive collaboration with businesses. This is how the institution plans to realise its objective of being a global leader in management education.

The core values of the Indian Institute of Management (IIM) in Nagpur are maintaining a positive bias towards excellence in thought and action, fostering ethical management, integrity, and commitment, continuous development through practices, creative mindset, productivity, and contributing to society. 

Why the IIM Nagpur?

The following points explain why IIM Nagpur courses offered are a fantastic option for management students:

Industry-Relevant Curriculum

To prepare its students for careers in business in the corporate world, IIM Nagpur's curriculum focuses on developing analytical, communication, and problem-solving abilities through both academic and practical approaches. The institute's partnerships with industry leaders also provide students with several internship and employment possibilities.

State-of-the-Art Infrastructure

The facilities of IIM Nagpur are some of the most cutting-edge in the world. Every building, as well as the library, computer lab, and restaurant is provided with Wi-Fi. There is a student activity centre for sports, cultural events, and other extracurricular pursuits at the institute.

Focus on Research and Innovation

IIM Nagpur faculty encourage students to carry out various research and innovation activities when attending top-notch IIM Nagpur courses offered . Several research centres at the institution focus on different aspects of management. Teachers and students alike are urged to do research and share what they discover at professional conferences and publications.

Strong Industry Connections

Students at IIM Nagpur benefit from its close ties with the corporate sector. These connections provide them an access to a wide variety of internship and employment options that bring with them opportunities to tackle real-world issues. The institution often hosts workshops, seminars, and lectures where renowned professionals are invited. 

Excellent Placement Record

Students who complete one of the IIM Nagpur courses offered are always in demand and hired by prestigious organisations in India and worldwide. Thanks to the institute's partnerships with industry giants that offer numerous internship and job possibilities with generous starting salaries and packages.

IIM Bodh Gaya is in the historical city of Bodh Gaya, Bihar. It is one of the prestigious business schools. Indian Institute of Management Bodh Gaya is the epitome of excellence in management education in India.

The institute was established in 2015 and will be amongst the top B-schools in 2023. Nurturing leaders and entrepreneurs, the institute is committed to providing a transformative learning experience to its students through a dynamic curriculum designed by academics and industry experts.

IIM of Bodh Gaya offers a student-friendly culture and rigorous curriculum that nurtures socially and emotionally responsible industry leaders. It was initially named IIM Bihar but later it was changed to IIM Bodh Gaya. It was one of the 5 IIMs set up under India's 2014 Union budget.

IIM Bodh Gaya is in the temple city of Bihar, Bodhgaya, which is also considered to be the most sacred site for Buddhists. For centuries, Bodh Gaya was the world's centre of learning. Since 2015, this prominent management school has imbibed the city's rich heritage and synchronized it with its teaching methodology. IIM BG is following the path to becoming 'The Enlightening IIM'. 

Indian Institute of Management IIM Bodh Gaya understands the value of exposing students to contemporary trends and international standards to enhance their learning environment. The institute has collaborated with reputable institutions in France, Venezuela, Russia, Mexico, Italy, and South Korea.

IIM Bodh Gaya follows its vision, i.e. "To be a globally recognised management school for developing socially responsible and mindful business leaders."

IIM Bodh Gaya's mission states, " To develop mindful leaders of business and social relevance in the global economy and to enhance academic excellence in learning practices and research."

This eminent institute runs on the following core values that are Responsibility, Honesty and Integrity, Life-long Learning, Diversity, Collaboration, and Mindfulness. 

Why the IIM Bodh Gaya?

The Indian Institute of Management IIM Bodh Gaya is also popular not just for academic excellence but also for its facilities, faculty members, and several other reasons. Take a look at all the key reasons to choose IIM Bodh Gaya: 

40+ World-Class Faculties 

The IIM Bodh Gaya faculty is reputable and well-known for their work and accomplishment in their respective fields. Each faculty member ensures quality education and a great learning experience for students. 

Best Placement Offers

There were stupendous 100% placements during the IIM Bodh Gaya 2023 Placements drive. The average salary was INR 16 LPA (33% hike) and the highest salary was INR 48.58 LPA (100% hike). About 70 recruiting companies were there including Amazon, BNY Mellon, Deloitte, HCL, Infosys, ICICI Bank etc. 

Student Exchange Program 

Bodh Gaya Institute of Management provides a student exchange program due to the great effort of the international relation committee. The institution has signed MOUs with 20+ renowned foreign institutions from all over the world. IIM Bodh Gaya’s students can get the chance to study in one of these institutions under the student exchange program. 

The Mindfulness Center

IIM Bodh Gaya has a fully functional, remarkable mindfulness centre called Samadhvam, which helps students learn and practice mindfulness. Through diverse practice, it will teach future managers and leaders how to cope with stress, workload, and a rigorous curriculum. This mindfulness centre ensures that IIM Bodh Gaya is on its path to developing mindful leaders who are socially relevant to the country.
